scope.frame: B1804's holomorphic flux frame (abelian surfaces with real multiplication by Z[phi] on which LR acts holomorphically); one U(1) bundle; the T^4 index read as the generation number (CHOSEN, cf. I-34); the null B_t, t = 4..7

claim_one_line: THREE GENERATIONS CUT A CURVE, NOT A POINT (P-419, selection by inversion, in B1804's holomorphic flux frame; data-free; NEGATIVE for 'three selects the moduli'): one LR-invariant flux with index -3 is (1,1) exactly on a curve of Hirzebruch-Zagier form; a point needs a second flux with free integers and such points are infinitely many (LR: 48 in a small box, 14 NS determinants); three or more independent fluxes have no common point; the same for the null matrices B_4..B_7 and for every generation number (U in Lambda_A); chi(L) < 0 for every invariant (1,1) flux on every holomorphic component, the index in a fixed orientation -3 on HxH and +3 on HxH^-: the hand CHOSEN. A short corollary of B1804 with U in Lambda_A. None of the 19.
